what: Screen-height plates (video and photo cards) stick to the screen one after another (sticky), and the next plate rises from below to cover it. The whole time the next plate rises from the bottom of the screen, the previous plate’s image shrinks from 1.05 to 1, and once the next plate’s top edge crosses the 33% line of the screen, a background-color veil over the previous plate deepens from 0 to 1 until it reaches the top (both bound to scroll with no curve)

options.zoom: Initial scale of the front panel image, default 1.05
options.veil: Next-section position where the curtain starts to darken (ScrollTrigger start), default top 33%
options.--fx-top · --fx-h: Sticky position and minimum panel height (via style), default 0 · 100svh
options.[data-fx-part=media]: (if present) wrapper for image or video that shrinks within the panel
options.[data-fx-part=veil]: (if present) a curtain you placed yourself — otherwise the part makes one
